omission_reason: RYA-1315: Kitt Peak Kurucz-corrected Ti II near-IR pool is 2 lines (9432.4, 9748.3) inside the 9300-9800 A water band; 9432 reads 5.68 at red_chi2 66 and the product 5.30 +/- 0.38, while the same two lines read 4.81 on IAG and 4.84 on the molecfit-corrected Kitt Peak atlas. The Kurucz telluric division leaves the line unfittable; the IAG and molecfit products stand for this cell
